text: {"frames":["Pim ran up to the crooked house with the hoist beam, and every window glowed gold. Nobody was inside, and the lamps hummed softly like bees. Your furry creature sniffed at the door, which stood open a crack. There are {c} lamps in all, and the glow has to be split evenly between the front room and the back room. How many lamps shine in each room?","\"This canal isn't on the map,\" said Lot, tapping the old paper. The blue line ran straight through a polder where no water had ever been. At the end of it a little lock was drawn, with {c} boats waiting in a row. The boats must be shared evenly between the water on the left of the lock and the water on the right. How many boats go on each side of the lock?","Cheese! Bas heard a fiddle tune drifting up from the cellar, though nobody was down there to play. On the shelves sat {c} cheese wheels, and one of them seemed to hum along. The cheese maker wants the wheels split evenly between the upper shelf and the lower shelf before the tune stops. How many wheels will go on the upper shelf?","Femke counted the wooden clogs by the stairs, and she counted {c} in all. Nobody had heard a step all night, yet the stairs led up to a floor that wasn't on the plan. The clogs must be shared out evenly between the upper landing and the lower landing, or the door will not open. How many clogs go on the upper landing?","Crunch, crunch went something on the canal ice, though nobody was skating. Thijs found footprints that began in the middle of the ice and went nowhere. There were {c} prints in all, and they ran in a line towards the mill. Thijs thinks the prints went out and came back the same way, with equal numbers on each way. How many prints are on the way out?"]}
